text.tspan: User's detail - prosumers (NIC is the primary key)
Indexes: Users.Username and Users.Email (unique) · Reservations (ProsumerNIC, SlotTime), (NodeId, SlotTime), QrToken, SlotId · EnergyBookingSlots (NodeId, StartTime)
Prosumers are keyed by NIC; references between collections are stored as string ids and resolved by the API (no client touches the database).
